snippet.title: Bioysque Trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for my upcoming Retro style Action RPG game for PC (2025).

*** some AI is used in the creation of this game. Particularly:  about 15% of all graphics is generated (heavily edited and often redrawn afterwards). Most of the game is still human-drawn.
